claims.text: Division's highest-scoring sides UCCS and Midwestern State meet next UCCS have scored eleven goals in two matches without conceding, and across the division only Midwestern State have scored as many. The Rocky Mountain Athletic Conference side and the Lone Star Conference side will never share a table, but their next match is against each other.
